contract: one font file read from memory; every face of a collection, each loaded at the case's 26.6 pixel height as libass requests it, as in font-scaled
for every glyph the advance of FreeType's default (hinted) load, which libass's HarfBuzz callbacks report; packets count advances
an advance the candidate cannot give (unsupported hinting) ends its operation with an error, so the case fails; it is never counted as agreement
the file is read before each timed and memory operation; the reference library is created once, outside it
